guide_subtitle: Application usage, inner mechanics, and developer architecture
guide_user_quickstart_desc:
Follow these basic steps to get started with Stokendra:
1. Stock Cards: Define inventory items (e.g., A4 Paper, Ethernet Cable).
2. Stock Movements: Update stock levels using 'New Movement' with [Entry] or [Exit] operations.
3. Service Records: Track devices sent to maintenance or technical service in real time.
4. Reports & Charts: Analyze top-consumed items and critical stock alerts from the Dashboard.
5. Security & Settings: The system takes automated daily backups. You can also export the database or ZIP/SQL archive anytime.
guide_user_stockcards_desc:
Organize your inventory hierarchically in a tree structure (Parent/Child card relationships):
• Parent Card: Acts strictly as a grouping category/folder. It holds no physical stock and cannot directly receive movements (e.g. 'Computer Hardware' or 'Network Equipment').
• Child Card: Physical items that carry active stock balances and receive entry/exit movements. Link Child cards to Parents using the dropdown.
• Minimum Stock: Critical inventory threshold. Falling below this limit triggers instant red alerts on the Dashboard and reports.
• Units: Measure items in Pieces, Meters, Boxes, or Packs.
guide_user_movements_title: Stock Entry & Exit Operations and Bulk Excel Import
guide_user_movements_desc:
Stock movements are the dynamic driver of inventory levels:
• Stock Entry: Log newly purchased, transferred, or surplus items.
• Stock Exit: Record items issued to departments or staff. Log the recipient person and department for full accountability.
• Bulk Movement Entry: Use 'Bulk Entry/Exit' to assign quantities to multiple stock cards at once on a single screen.
• Excel Import/Export: Import thousands of movements via Excel templates in seconds or export filtered movement records without row loss.
guide_user_services_desc:
A dedicated module to manage devices in maintenance or repair:
• Create Service Record: Record device name, serial number, service contractor, failure details, and maintenance date.
• Bulk Editing: Select multiple rows to batch-update service dates, companies, issues, or resolution results at once.
• Reporting & Print: Generate clean printable service summary sheets or export complete history to Excel.
guide_user_backup_desc:
Built-in mechanisms ensuring data protection and zero data loss:
• Daily Auto Backups: Stokendra creates an automatic dated backup copy of your database file (.db) on its first daily launch.
• Full Excel & ZIP Archive: Exports all tables into readable Excel spreadsheets bundled inside a timestamped ZIP archive.
• Health Check & VACUUM: Run 'Integrity Check' (PRAGMA quick_check) and 'Optimize Database' (VACUUM) from Settings to reclaim unused disk space and optimize performance.
guide_user_reports_desc:
Turn raw transaction logs into actionable analytical insights:
• ScottPlot Interactive Charts: Visualize top-consumed stock cards, department allocations, and stock depletion alerts.
• Filtered Consumption Reports: Query consumption by custom date spans, departments, or categories.
• Complete Unpaged Export: Regardless of page size, Export and Print include all records matching your active filters.
• Clean Browser Printing: Render modern HTML/CSS printable documents ready for physical printers or PDF export.
guide_dev_perf_title: SQLite Performance, High Speed & Tuning Engine
guide_dev_perf_desc:
To ensure sub-millisecond query responses even with thousands of records, the database is tuned with these settings:
• Memory-Mapped I/O (mmap_size = 256MB): Maps database file reads directly into virtual memory, avoiding physical disk latency and speeding up reads on SSD/HDD.
• Large Memory Cache (cache_size = 128MB): Keeps active database pages in memory to reduce disk G/C.
• WAL Mode (Write-Ahead Logging): Prevents write operations from blocking reads, ensuring parallel responsiveness.
• journal_size_limit (64MB) & Incremental Auto-Vacuum: Keeps WAL files compact and prevents database bloat.
guide_dev_mvvm_desc:
The project structure strictly adheres to clean MVVM (Model-View-ViewModel) guidelines:
• ViewModels: Leverage the CommunityToolkit.Mvvm library. Boilerplate logic for `[ObservableProperty]` and `[RelayCommand]` is automatically handled by C# Source Generators at compile time.
• Dependency Injection: Built on top of Microsoft DI Container. Shared services like `IStockCardRepository`, `IMovementRepository`, and `IDialogService` along with ViewModels are registered and resolved using constructor injection.
guide_dev_folders_desc:
• Views: Avalonia UI XAML layouts (.axaml) and views code-behind.
• ViewModels: Houses application flow control, data-binding parameters, and commands (ICommand).
• Models: Represents database tables and supports property change notifications (INotifyPropertyChanged).
• Data: Coordinates SQLite connection factories, repository implementations, and incremental migrations (`Database.Migrations.cs`).
• Services: ClosedXML-backed spreadsheet imports/exports and ZipArchive backups.
• Infrastructure: Localization manager, AppInfo and custom XAML markup extensions.
guide_dev_lang_desc:
The multi-language system runs on dynamic JSON localization resources:
• Resource Files: Over 570+ keys are stored with exact 1-to-1 parity in 'Resources/lang_tr.json' and 'lang_en.json'.
• XAML Integration: The custom '{infra:L key}' markup extension binds localized text cleanly throughout all XAML views.
• Language Switching: Changing language in Settings persists the preference and cleanly restarts the application with refreshed UI bindings.
guide_dev_db_desc:
Dapper micro-ORM is preferred over bulky frameworks like Entity Framework to avoid execution overhead and run raw SQL queries directly:
• Database Migrations: Incrementing `CurrentSchemaVersion` triggers automatic, data-loss-free database migrations. The engine reads SQLite user_version pragma and executes migrations (e.g. V14, V15) sequentially to adjust columns and indexes.
guide_dev_roadmap_desc:
• v7.4.0 Achievements: Centralized AppInfo versioning, User Roles & Security (PBKDF2 600K), Activity Audit Logging, Notes Module, Bulk Edit dialogs, Unpaged Excel/Print exports, In-App Updater, and 100% Synchronized Bilingual UI.
• Upcoming Roadmap:
1. Barcode & QR Code Integration: Instant card lookup and movement entry via USB barcode scanners.
2. Cloud & Multi-Client Sync: Real-time multi-workstation sharing using PostgreSQL/Firebase adapters.
3. Automated Alerts: Email notifications triggered when critical stock thresholds are breached.

guide_user_notes_desc:
An integrated scratchpad for daily warehouse operations, vendor notes, and reminders:
• Add & Edit Notes: Organize notes with titles and rich descriptions.
• Instant Search: Filter instantly across all archived notes by title or keywords.
• Bulk Actions: Select multiple notes to prepend title tags or append extra notes simultaneously.
guide_user_users_desc:
Multi-user access control and role-based authorization:
• Admin vs User Roles: Administrators can manage system settings, users, and database maintenance; standard Users focus on operational data entry.
• High-Grade Encryption: Passwords use PBKDF2 with 600,000 iterations (v4 upgrade); weak passwords or those containing the username are rejected.
• Emergency Recovery: Forgotten passwords can be reset immediately using the Master Security Code configured in Settings.
guide_user_updates_title: Live Updates & Release Delivery (In-App Live Updater)
guide_user_updates_desc:
Stokendra stays up-to-date and secure seamlessly:
• Silent Version Checks: Checks GitHub Releases silently upon startup for newer releases.
• One-Click Update Banner: An intuitive top banner notifies you when an update is available; 'Download & Install' downloads the setup package in the background and launches the installer.
• Release Notes: Review newly added features and bug fixes directly from the application.
guide_dev_excel_desc:
Data imports are fortified with ExcelImportHelper built on top of ClosedXML:
• Smart Date Parsing: Automatically recognizes Excel OLE serial dates (e.g. 45678.5), ISO strings, and localized date text.
• Culture-Invariant Decimals: Parses decimal numbers safely whether using commas or dots ('15,5' vs '15.5') with zero data loss.
• Dynamic Column Synonyms: Matches Turkish and English column headers automatically (e.g. 'bakım tarihi' / 'service date') for seamless import flexibility.
